segments.label: Sign in in the system browser

messages.label: Sign in — a ViewModel command, never a fetch in the View
open the OIDC authorize URL (PKCE challenge)
stored — never in AsyncStorage, MMKV, a log or the bundle
GET /orders — the SDK attaches the bearer

cards.title: Where the token lives
items: TokenStore and SecretStore are ports owned by the SDK and the ViewModel; the keystore adapter is the only implementation that touches the platform
a token in AsyncStorage, MMKV, a log line or the bundle is a finding, not a shortcut — the SDK attaches the header and the View never reads it
clear user data on sign-out and on a tenant switch; a shared device is the default assumption

cards.title: The browser is the boundary
items: the system browser runs OIDC with PKCE, so the app never holds the password and the code is bound to the verifier the app generated
a deep link received while signed out is queued and resumed after login — not dropped and not replayed blindly
an unknown route falls back to the not-found screen; the parser allowlists the host and validates every parameter

cards.title: The server decides
items: 401 means the access token expired: refresh with rotation, and a reused refresh token is treated as a compromise and revokes the family
403 is a stable forbidden state the screen renders with the required permission — hiding the button was never the control
jailbreak or root is evaluated server-side as a risk signal; the client never blocks on it, and pinning ships only with a rotation plan
